package.description: A native desktop application for the leading time tracking tool Toggl Track

en-US.description: A native desktop application for the leading time tracking tool Toggl Track
en-US.longDescription: Toggl Track for Windows is a native Windows application that can be installed on your computer. It works seamlessly with the web version of Toggl Track, syncing data on the fly. The desktop app also works offline; it stores data locally and sends it to the Toggl Track server once you’re back online.
en-US.name: Toggl Track

zh-CN.description: 一款专为领先的时间追踪工具 Toggl Track 打造的原生桌面应用程序
zh-CN.longDescription: Toggl Track for Windows 是一款专为 Windows 系统设计的本地应用程序，可直接安装在您的电脑上。它与 Toggl Track 的网页版无缝衔接，能够实时同步数据。此外，这款桌面应用还支持离线使用；数据会先存储在本地，待您重新联网后便会自动上传至 Toggl Track 服务器。
